reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is grounded in established successes of applying ML potentials to complex phases, although some uncertainty remains about completeness of training data and generalization to various compositions.
reasons.testability: They propose a well-defined parallel comparison of DNN-based and EAM references via thermodynamic integration and free-energy benchmarking, offering a clear route to falsification.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a focused solution to a recognized bottleneck in free-energy simulations of high-entropy alloys and proposes a feasible path forward, making it very attractive for researchers in this area.
